svg.title: The train arrives within Riju's range as Cecil finds a school-record conflict.
svg.desc: Passengers board calmly when the train arrives within the displayed range. Ghori settles by the safe marker while Cecil turns to report that one passenger is simultaneously marked present at School No. 3.
svg.text: Page 15, panel 5 · Wide platform shot as the train enters within the displayed range

text.tspan: Accurate range information improves the station
immediately, then Cecil finds a passenger
